workarounds.symptom: core: `_convert_to_v1_from_anthropic` mutates message.content when lifting `index` off an unrecognized block
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): avoid mutating message content in Anthropic translator. Target files: libs/core/langchain_core/messages/block_translators/anthropic.py, libs/core/tests/unit_tests/messages/block_translators/test_anthropic.py, libs/core/tests/unit_tests/messages/block_translators/test_bedrock.py. `_convert_to_v1_from_anthropic`'s fallback branch for an unrecognized content block wraps the original block by reference (`new_block["value"] = block`) and then pops `"index"` off of it. workarounds.symptom: ChatAnthropic/_create_usage_metadata crashes with TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +=: 'int' and 'NoneType' when cache_creation contains an explicit None value
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(anthropic): handle null cache-creation token counts. Target files: libs/partners/anthropic/langchain_anthropic/chat_models.py, libs/partners/anthropic/tests/unit_tests/test_chat_models.py. Prevent `ChatAnthropic` from crashing when a provider returns null cache-creation TTL counts. Preserve omission of null token details and correct the regression test to expect the missing key. (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/pull/41553)
